policy: SIMBAD objects whose compiled Johnson V is contradicted by Tycho-2, Gaia DR3 and 2MASS photometry of the same position are not naked-eye stars and leave the catalog. Each full former row stays here.

objects.reason: SIMBAD's compiled V = 6.408 (2000A&A...355L..27H) does not describe HD 17706: Tycho-2 measures VT = 8.549 and BT = 8.887 at its position (TYC 4056-1120-1), Gaia DR3 gives G = 8.51 and 2MASS J = 7.66. At V of about 8.5 the star is not visible to the naked eye.
